{{Top|leg}}
A luxury [[Hotel/Legends|resort]] '''hunting lodge''' existed in a [[jungle/Legends|jungle]] game preserve of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It boasted first-class rooms and entertainment and hunting facilities. [[Whool (Rodian)|Whoool]] maintained a local shop.
==History==
Sales executives [[Teeko Soonca]], [[Ruku Kooff]] and [[Mannee Swaano]], invited a group of off-worlder customers to the lodge in order to bond and finalize an agreement. Swaano knew Kooff's real identity and used the expedition as an opportunity to sell her to [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].

During their stay, the Rodians entertained their guests with samples of Rodian culture, such as a practice hunting trip with [[Target drone/Legends|target drones]] in a secure compound, a performance of ''[[Kinzic]]'', and nights full of [[sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] and [[alcohol]]. Their guests had to deal with curious bounty hunters and [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza]] [[Protector (Rin'na)|Protectors]] who bullied the off-worlders.

The visit coincided with the visit of an [[Unidentified elderly Rodian|elderly Rodian]] who wished to [[death/Legends|die]] fighting a predator in her last hunt.

Meanwhile, bounty hunters who were after Kooff, broke into the rooms, planted [[transponder beacon/Legends|transponders]] in their luggage, and tampered with their [[comlink/Legends|comlinks]] and [[Blaster power pack/Legends|power packs]]. They also provided tampered goods to Whool, and sabotaged the [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] that was planned to take them to the hunting expedition.

Indeed, despite the break-in, the Rodians and their customers would proceed as planned, and after attempting to buy supplies from Whool, half an hour on their way to the hunting camp, their sabotaged airspeeder broke down. Stranded in the jungle, the group attempted to find their way back to the lodge through rivers, [[Quicksand/Legends|quicksands]] and fight predators with their tampered equipment.
